pages.text: Sets the temperature of a sealed room.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: Place it inside a sealed room and right-click.$(br2)$(bold)10-30°C$(), in 5°C steps, for every heater in the room.

pages.title: Merged Rooms
pages.text: The newest thermostat wins; others show $(bold)Overridden$(). Splitting restores them. Removing the winner hands control to the next newest.$(br2)All of it survives reloads.

pages.title: Room Reading
pages.text: It reads the shared room temperature the HUD uses, before your gear and effects.$(br2)Core, campfire and furnace heat is part of that reading.

pages.title: Limits
pages.text: It throttles heaters only. It can't switch off a Core, put out a fire or cool.$(br2)If those overshoot, use a $(l:heating/heat_vent)Heat Vent$(/l).

pages.title: After a Breach
pages.text: It shows $(bold)No seal$(); heaters fall back to 20°C until you repair. Unknown or unloaded rooms pause.$(br2)Wall heat survives a breach or restart.

pages.title: Camps
pages.text: Placed outdoors in Phases 1-4, a new thermostat runs camp heaters within $(bold)8 blocks$().$(br2)Once bound to a room it stays indoor. Re-place it for a camp.
Four iron, two copper, two redstone, one glass.$(br2)$(flavor)Place the sensor near the occupant. The occupant is usually you.$()

pages.title: Specs
pages.text: $(li)10-30°C in 5°C steps$(li)Comparator: 0 at 0°C or colder, 15 at 30°C or warmer$(li)Keeps a loaded room simulated without a fueled heater$(li)Loads no chunks, supplies no oxygen$(li)Burn % is a short average
